Players Committee card image of [[Binder]] (original printing), game text: “May add 6 pilots or passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Your starships may move to here as a 'react.' For opponent to move a starship from here requires +1 Force. Immune to attrition < 4.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual2-Dark/large/binder.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.
